import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
old=json.loads((root/"benchmark_tools/results/native_fas_context_probe_20261010_v1.json").read_text())
path=root/"benchmark_tools/results/native_fas_context_probe_20261010_v2.json"
data=json.loads(path.read_text())
assert old["assessment"]["executed_contexts"]==1 and old["assessment"]["pair_evaluations"]==0
assert old["contexts"][0]["terminal"]["returncode"]==1 and "pfam is missing" in old["contexts"][0]["terminal"]["stderr"]
mapping={key:key.lower() for key in ("Pfam","SMART","fLPS","COILS2","SEG","SignalP","TMHMM")}
expected=json.loads(json.dumps(old["fixture_annotations"]))
for doc in expected.values():
 for gene,features in doc["feature"].items():
  doc["feature"][gene]={mapping.get(key,key):value for key,value in features.items()}
assert data["fixture_annotations"]==expected and data["owners"]==old["owners"] and data["tool_key_normalization"]==mapping
assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()==data["fixture_sha256"]
assert data["native_path_counts"]=={"C":2**16,"F":2**16,"G":2**50}
focal=[["A","D"],["B","E"],["C","F"],["G","H"]]
companions=[["I","J"],["K","L"]]
full=focal+companions
plan=[("singleton_"+str(i),[pair],1,"0") for i,pair in enumerate(focal)]
plan += [("full_forward_one",full,1,"0"),("full_reverse_one",full[::-1],1,"0"),("full_rotated_two",full[2:]+full[:2],2,"0"),("full_reverse_two_hash1",full[::-1],2,"1")]
plan += [("subset_"+str(i),[companions[0],pair,companions[1]],2,"0") for i,pair in enumerate(focal)]
assert len(data["contexts"])==len(plan)==12
observed={}; count={}; numeric=na=0
for row,(name,pairs,workers,seed) in zip(data["contexts"],plan):
 assert row["context"]==dict(name=name,pairs=pairs,workers=workers,hash_seed=seed)
 assert row["error"] is None and row["terminal"]["returncode"]==0 and not row["terminal"]["timed_out"]
 argv=row["terminal"]["command"]
 assert argv[0]=="fas.runMultiTaxa" and argv[argv.index("--cpus")+1]==str(workers)
 assert argv[argv.index("--max_cardinality")+1]=="40" and argv[argv.index("--paths_limit")+1]=="15"
 assert argv[argv.index("--pairLimit")+1]=="30000" and all(flag in argv for flag in ("--bidirectional","--tsv","--domain","--no_config","--json","--mergeJson"))
 raw=json.loads(row["raw_text"])
 assert raw==row["raw"] and set(raw)=={"_".join(pair) for pair in pairs}
 for pair in pairs:
  key="_".join(pair); directions=raw[key]
  assert isinstance(directions,list) and len(directions)==2 and all(isinstance(value,str) for value in directions)
  if "NA" in directions:
   assert pair==["G","H"] and directions==["NA","NA"]
   returned=False; value=None; na+=1
  else:
   scores=[float(x) for x in directions]
   assert all(math.isfinite(x) and 0<=x<=1 for x in scores)
   returned=True; value=sum(scores)/2; numeric+=1
  normalized=dict(pair=pair,directions=directions,returned=returned,value=value)
  assert row["normalized"][key]==normalized
  if key in observed: assert observed[key]==normalized
  else: observed[key]=normalized
  count[key]=count.get(key,0)+1
assert numeric==34 and na==6 and sum(count.values())==40
assert all(count["_".join(pair)]==6 for pair in focal)
assert observed["A_D"]["value"]==1 and 0<observed["B_E"]["value"]<1 and observed["C_F"]["returned"]
assert data["assessment"]==dict(planned_contexts=12,executed_contexts=12,complete=True,pair_evaluations=40,failures=[],variations=[],all_tested_contexts_invariant=True)
assert data["status"]=="controlled_native_context_invariance_passed" and data["assessment_error"] is None
for key in ("historical_scores_rerun","historical_omissions_attributed","native_sampling_law_admitted","native_intervals_admitted","publication_ready"): assert data[key] is False
for key in ("scorer","calcFAS","calcFASmulti","engine","driver_original"):
 original="driver" if key=="driver_original" else key
 assert data["sources"][key]==old["sources"][original]
for key in ("driver","driver_original"):
 ref=data["sources"][key]; source=Path(ref["path"]).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"] and len(source)==ref["bytes"]
protocol=Path(data["protocol"]["path"]).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(protocol).hexdigest()==data["protocol"]["sha256"]
assert data["protocol"]==old["protocol"]
print(json.dumps(dict(status="independent_readback_passed",result_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),result_bytes=path.stat().st_size,contexts=12,pair_evaluations=40,numeric_returns=numeric,na_returns=na,focal_comparisons=20,pairs=observed,occurrences=count),sort_keys=True))
'
